detail.longDescription: Muse from Meta was #1 in the US App Store's Top Free Apps chart on every day from 18 Sep to 6 Oct 2026, 19 days in a row. ChatGPT, #1 on the 12 days to 18 Sep, has been #2 or #3 since. In the week to 6 Oct, Muse added 71.8K US ratings, more than twice as many as Google Gemini and Claude together.
